# Alg Trainer (Tao Yu)

The ZBLL and ZBLS algorithms in `lib/core/solver/zb/zbll_cases.dart` and
`zbls_cases.dart` come from `js/alg_list.js` of
[tao-yu/Alg-Trainer](https://github.com/tao-yu/Alg-Trainer), under the MIT
licence in `LICENSE` next to this file. `tool/zb/import_zb.dart` imports
them, keeping only algorithms that check out on this app's cube model.
